name: Hayami Reiji
source:
After hitting his head while playing around with his underclassman [url=/c18498]Fumika[/url] on the stairs, Reiji started hearing voices in his head occassionally. This sickness is already known by a considerable amount of people on his school, but no one treats him badly, thanks to his other special trait, his abnormally high charisma, which grants him friendship with people from both genders and different classrooms.

[Edited from [url=http://otakuoverdrive.com/2014/07/11/galge-review-semiramis-no-tenbin/]gangrelion's review[/url] and [url=https://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2014/07/29/nsfw-semiramis-no-tenbin-review/]aquaspirit39's review[/url]]
